# EMChat Media

> EMChat Media is a privacy-first social network — no ad trackers, no behavioural profiling, and no algorithmic feed. Founded in 2026 in North Macedonia by Egzon Mehmedi.

EMChat Media (https://emchat.social) lets people share posts and photos, follow a chronological feed of the accounts they choose, message privately (direct messages and group chats), and share a rich profile card. There is no advertising business behind it: no trackers, no data selling, no engagement-ranked feed.

## Key facts

- Name: EMChat Media (also referred to as EMChat)
- Founded: 2026, North Macedonia
- Founder: Egzon Mehmedi
- Pricing: Free to use
- Sign-in: Passwordless (one-time email link, no password)
- Privacy controls: private accounts, per-post visibility, follower approval, block and mute, one-click data export, one-click account deletion
- Photo privacy: uploaded images are re-encoded server-side to strip EXIF and GPS metadata
- Messaging: direct messages and group chats with photos, video and file attachments; message requests keep messages from people you don't follow out of your main inbox until you accept them

## Pages

- [Home](https://emchat.social/): product overview and sign-up

- [Explore](https://emchat.social/explore): public posts, viewable without an account

- [Terms of Service](https://emchat.social/terms)

## How EMChat Media differs from ad-funded platforms (Instagram, Facebook, X, TikTok)

EMChat Media has no algorithmic ranking — the feed is strictly chronological, showing posts from followed accounts in the order they were posted. It runs no advertising, so it has no incentive to maximize time-on-app or build behavioural ad-targeting profiles. It is not owned by or affiliated with Meta, X Corp, ByteDance, or any other social media company.
